admission.justification: Spans the shared filesystem helper and both terminal worktree modules (cleanup and abandon); dropping this reclamation target would leave pre-removal worktree groups non-empty and stuck during finalization or abandon.

applicability: Worktree cleanup and abandon directory reclamation on leaf and series enclosures that may carry a pre-removal provider-runtime folder.
conditions: Absence of <worktree_group>/provider-runtime is a no-op and omitted from series directory maps.
A genuine permission or OS removal error returns removed=False with its reason and blocks cleanup rather than succeeding silently.
exclusions: Docker-based ownership reclaim, which was removed with the providers package.
Relocation of summarize_command_logs to application/log_capture.py, which stays in onboarding prose.

evidence: pytest mcp/tests/test_terminal_blocker_reasons.py (passed); Reviewer route 1 pass at tree 8ae93710c4e6b5f660dd4d763f537ebaa437b42f

statement: Worktree cleanup and abandon reclaim any leftover <worktree_group>/provider-runtime directory directly via plain tree removal without a provider step, and block with the explicit filesystem reason if removal fails.
title: Worktree cleanup and abandon reclaim leftover provider-runtime directly
